description: Cleanup strength, smart formatting and the text before the cursor (ai/cleanup_strength.rs, ai/cleanup_format.rs, ai/cleanup_context.rs), for `yap.exe eval --strength`: dictations as speech-to-text writes them, each cleaned through the dictation's own code (`cleanup_styles::resolve` for a stand-in app of its kind, then `cleanup_styles::clean`) twice: **before** (the call every dictation made until 25 Oct 2026: Medium, no formatting line, no text before the cursor) and **after** (the case's strength, the formatting line when a list or an email frame is said, the text before the cursor in `before`). A case with `before` is judged after `smart_insert::fit_to_context` — what the field ends up with. `group`: strength | format | cursor. `strength`: light | medium | high (default medium). `category`: a kind of app (default other), `tone` one of its tones (default its own). `quick`: the cases a cloud model's run keeps (`--strength-quick`). Checks: those of styles.json (`has`, `has_any`, `not`, `exact`, `starts_with`, `lines_min`, `lowercase`, `keep`, `no_final_period`, `empty`, `max_words`), plus `keeps_words` (every word said but filler sounds and stutters is kept, at most `added_max` words added — default 1; apostrophes ignored, a number word may be a digit), `ratio_max` / `ratio_min` (its words against the dictation's, fillers out), `list_items` (at least n lines starting "1.", "-", "*" or "•"), `no_list` (one paragraph, no list line), `ends_with`, `not_starts_with` (any case), `first_line_max_words`, `last_line_has_any`. People and places are fictional.
